newsitem.title: USA: USDA says CCC interest rates dip in November.
newsitem.headline: USDA says CCC interest rates dip in November.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said the interest rate for 1996 crop year commodity loans disbursed by the Commodity Credit Corp (CCC) in November is 6.625 percent, down from 6.875 percent the prior month.
USDA said the November rate for 1995 and prior crop year commodity loans is 5.625 percent, down from 5.875 percent in October.
